info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Download Account Statement File API
info.description: The Download Account Statement File API allows users to retrieve specific account statements in file format for a given account. This functionality is essential for customers seeking to archive or review their financial transactions conveniently. By providing the account ID and statement ID, consumers such as financial institutions and application developers can access detailed statement documents programmatically. This API supports typical use cases involving financial reporting and data analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific file for a bank statement.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to download the specified file associated with a bank statement for a particular account. The account is identified by its unique ID (ACC-200045), and the statement is identified by its unique reference (RES-100045). Use this endpoint to access the electronic representation of financial statements.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the file associated with the specified account statement. This body must conform to the provided schema, which defines the required structure and data types. Ensure that any required fields are included for successful processing.

200.description: The requested file has been successfully retrieved.
